summary: San José, Costa Rica's vibrant capital nestled in the Central Valley, offers a perfect blend of urban energy, cultural richness, and easy access to stunning natural landscapes. Home to world-class museums, incredible farm-to-table cuisine, and a thriving arts scene, the city serves as an ideal base for exploring cloud forests, waterfalls, and coffee plantations. With its year-round spring-like climate and warm, welcoming people, San José embodies the true spirit of Costa Rican pura vida.

restaurants.name: Al Mercat
restaurants.description: Mediterranean-inspired fine dining restaurant showcasing seasonal ingredients and creative presentations. Award-winning chef delivers an exceptional culinary experience in an intimate, sophisticated setting.
restaurants.mustTry: Tasting menu with Costa Rican ingredients

restaurants.name: Silvestre
restaurants.description: Farm-to-table restaurant highlighting organic, locally-sourced ingredients with innovative cooking techniques. Intimate atmosphere featuring wood-fired preparations and natural wines.

restaurants.name: Castro's Bar and Disco
restaurants.description: Authentic San José local favorite serving traditional gallo pinto, casados, and fresh tropical juices. A neighborhood institution perfect for experiencing authentic Costa Rican breakfast culture.
restaurants.mustTry: Gallo pinto with fresh orange juice

restaurants.name: Café Británico
restaurants.description: Historic café and bookstore dating back decades, serving excellent Costa Rican coffee and light meals in a charming, bohemian atmosphere. Perfect for morning coffee and people-watching.

restaurants.name: Stiefel Pub
restaurants.description: German-style gastro pub offering craft beers and hearty European comfort food with a Costa Rican twist. Lively atmosphere with locals and travelers enjoying quality ingredients.

restaurants.name: Clemente
restaurants.description: Contemporary restaurant celebrating Costa Rican flavors with modern plating and techniques. Features local produce, sustainable seafood, and an excellent wine selection.

restaurants.name: Sikwa
restaurants.description: Modern Asian-fusion restaurant combining Thai, Japanese, and Costa Rican elements with fresh, vibrant flavors. Stylish setting popular with the younger San José crowd.

restaurants.name: La Terrasse de París
restaurants.description: French bistro delivering classic Parisian cuisine and atmosphere in the heart of San José. Cozy, romantic setting perfect for dinner with excellent wine pairings.

restaurants.name: Pomaire
restaurants.description: Chilean restaurant featuring traditional South American dishes with an emphasis on fresh seafood and quality meats. Warm ambiance reflecting Chilean hospitality.

restaurants.name: Kalú
restaurants.description: Casual café and casual dining spot serving traditional Costa Rican fare at unbeatable prices. Authentic experience with locals in a no-frills, honest environment.

restaurants.name: Silvestre Soda
restaurants.description: Traditional soda (small local eatery) offering authentic Costa Rican sodas and comidas. Simple, delicious, affordable meals prepared daily with care.

restaurants.name: Nuevo León de Castilla
restaurants.description: Long-standing local eatery famous for Costa Rican classics and seafood specialties. Family-run establishment with generations of authentic recipes and genuine hospitality.

activities.name: National Museum Tour
activities.description: Explore Costa Rica's history, pre-Columbian artifacts, and natural history in this former military barracks with beautiful courtyards. Comprehensive overview of Costa Rican culture and heritage.

activities.name: La Sabana Park Exploration
activities.description: Wander through San José's largest urban park featuring walking trails, museums, sports fields, and beautiful green spaces. Perfect for jogging, picnicking, or simply enjoying nature in the city.

activities.name: Central Market Tour
activities.description: Navigate the vibrant Mercado Central with its maze of stalls selling fresh produce, local crafts, and traditional foods. An authentic sensory experience showcasing local commerce and culture.

activities.name: Coffee Farm Tour (nearby)
activities.description: Visit a local coffee plantation in the Central Valley foothills to learn about cultivation, harvesting, and roasting of Costa Rican coffee. Includes tasting fresh brews and touring the processing facilities.

activities.name: Teatro Nacional Performance
activities.description: Catch a theatrical, musical, or dance performance at Costa Rica's most iconic theater with stunning Belle Époque architecture. Elegant evening experience celebrating local and international artists.

activities.name: Sprechsal Brewery Tour
activities.description: Tour a local craft brewery learning about beer production and Costa Rican craft beer culture. Includes tastings of unique brews and food pairings in a relaxed atmosphere.

activities.name: Poás Volcano Day Trip
activities.description: Drive to nearby Poás Volcano National Park to witness the dramatic crater lake and geothermal activity from observation points. Experience one of Costa Rica's most accessible and spectacular natural wonders.

activities.name: Jade Museum Visit
activities.description: Browse the world's largest collection of American jade artifacts with pieces spanning 2,500 years of pre-Columbian history. Fascinating insight into indigenous civilizations and artistic traditions.

activities.name: Art Gallery Walking Tour
activities.description: Self-guided exploration of San José's thriving contemporary art scene through numerous galleries and street art. Discover local artists and the city's creative energy in the Barrio Escalante neighborhood.

activities.name: Nightlife Experience in Castro
activities.description: Experience San José's vibrant nightlife in the Castro neighborhood with bars, clubs, and live music venues. Authentic local scene with energy, dancing, and social atmosphere.

activities.name: La Fortuna Waterfall Trek (day trip)
activities.description: Journey to nearby Arenal region for trekking through rainforest to reach the powerful La Fortuna Waterfall with swimming opportunities. Full-day adventure including cloud forest exploration.

activities.name: Farmers Market and Local Food Tour
activities.description: Visit weekend farmers markets to sample fresh tropical fruits, vegetables, and local delicacies while interacting with vendors. Guided or self-guided experience of San José's food culture.

spots.name: Teatro Nacional

spots.name: Central Market (Mercado Central)
spots.description: Vibrant bustling market with colorful produce, local vendors, and dynamic street scenes perfect for documentary and color photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning when freshest goods arrive

spots.name: Plaza de la Cultura
spots.description: Historic central square surrounded by colonial architecture and museums with excellent urban landscape photography opportunities.
spots.bestTime: Late afternoon for warm light and crowds

spots.name: Barrio Escalante Street Art
spots.description: Hip neighborhood covered in colorful murals and contemporary street art showcasing San José's creative scene.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour for dimensional street art shadows

spots.name: La Sabana Park at Sunset
spots.description: Large urban green space with silhouettes of joggers and sunset reflections on water features for landscape and lifestyle photography.

spots.name: Jade Museum Interiors
spots.description: Museum displays of ancient jade artifacts with professional lighting creating excellent still-life and detail photography opportunities.

spots.name: Eastern Market (Mercado Borbón)
spots.description: Authentic local market with fresh fish, spices, and colorful produce offering gritty street and food photography subjects.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for best light and activity

spots.name: Poás Volcano Crater Rim
spots.description: Dramatic volcanic landscape with crater lake and geothermal features providing striking landscape and nature photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning before clouds roll in

spots.name: Downtown Street Photography Walks
spots.description: Historic downtown streets with colonial buildings, local life, and urban architecture ideal for candid street photography.
spots.bestTime: Late afternoon for warm light and activity

spots.name: Coffee Plantations Landscape
spots.description: Lush green coffee fields on hillsides with mist and mountains creating beautiful agricultural landscape photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning with mist and fresh light

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for architecture and street scenes
50mm prime for intimate street photography and portraits
70-200mm telephoto for landscape compression at volcanoes
Macro lens for market details and food photography
photography.goldenHourNotes: San José's central valley location provides stunning golden hour light year-round, typically 6:30-7:30am and 4:30-5:45pm. The light beautifully illuminates colonial architecture and street scenes with warm tones. Cloud cover is frequent but creates diffused, even lighting ideal for portrait and street work without harsh shadows.

weather.seasonality: San José experiences a pronounced dry season (December-March) and rainy season (May-November), with transitional months offering variable conditions. The city's high elevation (1,172m) ensures consistently cool temperatures year-round, making it comfortable for activities regardless of season.
weather.summary: San José maintains pleasant spring-like weather throughout the year with temperatures between 17-21°C. The dry season provides the most sunshine and clarity for viewing volcanoes and outdoor activities, while the rainy season brings lush greenery but afternoon downpours that typically clear by evening.

hotels.name: Hotel Presidente
hotels.description: Reliable budget hotel in central location with basic but clean rooms, friendly staff, and convenient access to markets and cultural attractions.

hotels.name: Gran Via Hotel
hotels.description: Comfortable mid-range hotel offering modern amenities, restaurant, and excellent location near shopping districts and cultural sites with professional service.

hotels.name: Aurola Holiday Inn
hotels.description: Luxury five-star hotel overlooking La Sabana Park featuring fine dining, spa, fitness center, and elegant rooms with premium service and city views.
